For applications with deep dependency trees, this process can take seconds, even when most of the imported code is never actually used during a particular run. Developers have worked around this by moving imports inside functions, using importlib to load modules on demand, or restructuring code to avoid unnecessary dependencies. These approaches work but make code harder to read and maintain, scatter import statements throughout the codebase, and require discipline to apply consistently.
